svg.title: Clean Architecture layers in this Go backend template
svg.desc: Four concentric layers show domain at the center, surrounded by application policy, adapters, and composition and frameworks. Source dependencies point inward.

g.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif
g.text: cmd · internal/app · Echo · grpc-go · PostgreSQL · Redis · provider SDKs
delivery handlers and services · infrastructure stores, clients, and telemetry
usecases · repository contracts · shared technical contracts

g.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif
g.text: Outer code implements contracts owned by inner policy.

g.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif
g.text: Runtime calls can travel outward through injected interfaces; compile-time ownership still points inward.
